prompt: If they connect the laptop to the second screen but do not share that laptop in the meeting, what will happen?
promptZh: 如果筆電接到第二個螢幕，卻沒有在會議中分享筆電畫面，會發生什麼事？

options.text: The remote participants will see the laptop but not the slides.
options.zh: 遠端與會者會看到筆電畫面，但看不到投影片。
options.whyZh: 遠端接收的是現場電腦的畫面，投影片會從現場電腦播放。

options.text: People in the room can see the laptop demonstration, but remote participants cannot.
options.zh: 現場的人看得到筆電上的示範，遠端與會者則看不到。
options.whyZh: 接到第二個螢幕的筆電畫面只在現場顯示，遠端仍只能看到現場電腦分享的內容。

options.text: Everyone will see the laptop automatically once a cable is connected.
options.zh: 只要接上線，所有人就會自動看到筆電畫面。
options.whyZh: 接到現場的第二個螢幕，不等於在遠端會議中分享筆電畫面。

options.text: Neither group will be able to see any screen.
options.zh: 現場和遠端的人都看不到任何螢幕畫面。
options.whyZh: 不分享筆電不會讓現場螢幕或現場電腦的分享失效。

explanationZh: 接到第二個螢幕的筆電畫面只在現場顯示，遠端仍只能看到現場電腦分享的內容。
evidence: connect your laptop to the second screen. / The second screen shows whatever is connected to it / people joining remotely only see what the room computer shares. / Then they would miss the order demonstration.
